args.title: Add bounded retries to the outbound client
args.prompt: Add bounded retry handling to the outbound HTTP client in src/client.rs. Retry only on transport failures and 5xx responses, cap attempts at three, and use exponential backoff with jitter. Do not retry 4xx responses.
args.objective: Transient network failures stop surfacing as user-visible errors.
context: src/client.rs currently issues a single request with no retry.
The transcript describes intermittent failures during deploys.
requirements: Retry transport errors and 5xx responses at most three times.
Use exponential backoff with jitter between attempts.
constraints: Do not add a new dependency.
acceptance_criteria: A 503 response is retried and the call succeeds when the third attempt returns 200.
A 400 response is returned to the caller without a retry.
assumptions: The existing client is the only outbound HTTP path.
